title: Request: add option to turn off "NO BLUETOOTH" vibration on Pebble watchfaces (trend face)
symptom: When using the G5 with xDrip and a Pebble 2, the user often gets "NO BLUETOOTH" alerts because the app resets bluetooth when it doesn't get a signal from the G5. This wakes the user up multiple times a night.
cause: The 'No Bluetooth' alert is created by the watch face itself, unlike other alerts, so it needs different handling to create an option for it.
fix: Install the 9th Aug Nightly release, then go to Settings -> Smartwatch Settings -> Pebble -> Vibrate when no bluetooth option and uncheck it. The setting requires an updated watch face; switch off and on the top slider 'Pebble Watch Integration' to trigger reinstallation.
evidence_quote: After that look in `Settings` -> `Smartwatch Settings` -> `Pebble` -> `Vibrate when no bluetooth` option which can be unchecked.
